title: Fundamentals of Probability

title: Matrix Methods in Data Analysis, Signal Processing, and Machine Learning

title: Circuits and Electronics

title: Linear Circuits 2: AC Analysis

title: Introduction to Electronics, Signals, and Measurement

title: Hands-On Introduction to Electrical Engineering Lab Skills
risk: Uses dated 555-timer and TTL parts and provides no exercise-feedback spine.

title: Real Analog Courses

title: Introduction to Circuits for Electrical and Computer Engineers
risk: Some notes are missing; homework and labs have no solutions, and exams are absent.

title: Microelectronics
risk: No videos and taught in 2016, but 27 notes, twelve solved homeworks, solved exams, and three regular solved labs form a strong spine; Lab 4 is optional bonus work without a public solution.

title: Microelectronic Devices and Circuits
risk: No video; design tooling and process references are dated.

prerequisite_note.en: Berkeley EE 105 course information expects EE 40-level KCL/KVL, node analysis, impedance, Bode plots, and basic instrument use

prerequisite_note.en: The MIT 6.301 syllabus requires 6.012 and assumes the Bode plots, Laplace transforms, transfer functions, and complex impedance of 6.003

prerequisite_note.en: The MIT 6.331 syllabus requires 6.301 and 6.302 and explicitly says no equivalents are accepted

title: Analog Circuits
risk: Current 2026 videos and weekly assignments, but no laboratory, code, or public solution feedback.

title: Integrated Circuits, MOSFETs, OP-Amps and Their Applications

title: Analog IC Design

title: Digital Design and Computer Architecture
risk: The official landing page links complete 2025 videos and materials; the Safari-hosted material server needs a manual robots and download-health check.

prerequisite_note.en: The official Nand2Tetris site states that Part I requires no prior knowledge

risk: The HDL simulator and projects are self-contained, but Coursera trial, payment, and full-course access terms can change.

title: Build a Modern Computer from First Principles: From Nand to Tetris, Part II

recommended_background.zh: 入门编程能力；第一部分可配套学习，但第二部分官方说明为自成体系
recommended_background.en: Introductory programming; Part I is a useful companion, but the provider describes Part II as self-contained

risk: Six substantial projects require Python or Java setup, and Coursera access terms can change.

title: Digital Logic and Computer Organization
risk: Only lecture notes are public; there are no open homework sets, exams, or laboratories.

title: Introductory Digital Systems Laboratory

risk: The Verilog laboratories and final projects are strong, but the FPGA boards and EDA workflow are dated.

title: Digital Systems Laboratory

prerequisite_note.en: Illinois's ECE 385 department page and catalogue list ECE 110 and ECE 220 as prerequisites

title: Digital Design and Integrated Circuits
tier_note: A curriculum identity / B public completion

Search-engine-indexed static lecture and lab pages are not directly landable. The ASIC flow requires institutional VCS/DC/Innovus access and the FPGA path requires Vivado plus a PYNQ-class board; this is a curriculum-and-assessment companion, not a publicly executable course.

title: Digital Systems Architecture
risk: The public Winter 2026 page exposes the topic and reading schedule plus the names and release dates of Homework 1–3 and Lab 1–4. Complete handouts, starters, slides, solutions, Gradescope, FPGA allocation, and feedback require SUNet or Canvas access, so this is a restricted syllabus index rather than an independently executable course.

title: Computer Architecture

prerequisite_note.en: Cornell ECE 4750 course materials assume foundations in programming, digital logic and organization, and systems programming

risk: RISC-V notes, problems, and laboratory descriptions are public, but the group repository, server, and some starter code are private.

title: Computer System Architecture

prerequisite_note.en: The MIT 6.823 syllabus requires 6.004 or equivalent preparation

risk: Architecture examples are old, and the public problems and exams do not include a complete solution loop.

title: Complex Digital Systems

title: Analysis and Design of Digital Integrated Circuits

prerequisite_note.en: The MIT 6.374 syllabus expects 6.012 or equivalent device physics and 6.004 or equivalent logic design

title: VLSI Systems

title: Hardware Acceleration via FPGA

Verilog-titled YouTube lectures count as video, not code; Quartus 18.1 and board availability are the main reproducibility constraints.

title: Operating System Engineering

risk: The RISC-V xv6 laboratories are current, but there is no full video series or public grading feedback.

title: Essentials of PCB Design

title: Digital Systems Design Using Microcontrollers

title: Computer Systems from the Ground Up
risk: Spring 2026 lectures are not recorded, and the required Mango Pi board and kit have variable regional availability. Only limited public lecture sample-code directories were verified; enrolled-course starter and staff repositories are not public.

prerequisite_note.en: Berkeley EECS 149 Fall 2015 logistics list EECS 16B or 20, CS 61C, and EECS 70 or Math 55

risk: The open textbook is strong, but recorded course captures, laboratories, hardware, and toolchains are dated.

title: ECE Practice and Design
